title: Comprehensions
explain: A comprehension builds a list, set or dictionary in one readable line. The shape is `[expression for item in items if condition]`. Use it for simple transforms and keep a normal loop when the logic gets long.
exercise: From a list of words, build a new list holding only the words longer than three letters, in uppercase.
tip: Don't cram several conditions and nested loops into one comprehension. If it needs a second look to read, use a plain loop.
